title: Quantity surveyor/ estimator-RCC and Steel
description:
Quantity Estimator & BOQ Preparer Company: OptiStruX Consulting Engineers LLP
 Location: Greater Noida West, Uttar Pradesh
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Experience: 3+ years preferred About the Role OptiStruX Consulting Engineers LLP is looking for an experienced Quantity Estimator & BOQ Preparer with a proven track record in accurately estimating quantities for high-rise RCC and structural steel buildings . The candidate will be responsible for preparing detailed quantity take-offs, BOQs, material estimates, and cost-related documentation based on structural and architectural drawings. Key Responsibilities Prepare accurate quantity take-offs and BOQs for RCC, structural steel, and associated construction works. Estimate quantities for high-rise RCC buildings , including foundations, basements, columns, beams, slabs, shear walls, retaining walls, staircases, etc. Prepare quantity estimates for structural steel buildings , including primary and secondary steel members, connections, plates, bolts, and other components. Read and interpret structural, architectural, and construction drawings . Prepare detailed reinforcement steel (rebar) quantities and BBS , including bar lengths, weights, laps, couplers, and wastage where applicable. Prepare concrete, reinforcement, structural steel, masonry, and other construction quantity statements. Cross-check quantities against drawings and structural design requirements to ensure accuracy. Identify discrepancies, omissions, and changes between drawings and BOQs. Assist in preparing rate analysis, cost estimates, and tender documentation where required. Coordinate with structural engineers, architects, contractors, and project teams to clarify drawings and quantities. Maintain organized quantity sheets, BOQs, revisions, and supporting calculations. Required Qualifications & Experience Diploma/Degree in Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management , or a related field. Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in quantity estimation and BOQ preparation. Proven experience in quantity estimation for high-rise RCC buildings is mandatory. Strong experience with structural steel quantity estimation is required. Ability to independently prepare quantities from detailed structural and architectural drawings. Strong understanding of RCC construction, reinforcement detailing, structural steel, and construction methodology. Proficiency in MS Excel and quantity take-off/estimation software. Knowledge of AutoCAD and ability to interpret drawings is preferred. Strong attention to detail and a high level of numerical accuracy. Preferred Experience Candidates with experience working on G+15, G+20 and higher residential/commercial towers , basements, podiums, and large structural steel projects will be preferred. What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who can independently produce reliable and accurate quantities , rather than someone whose experience is limited to basic residential quantity estimation. The candidate should be comfortable working with large and technically complex structural drawings and should have a demonstrated ability to identify quantities accurately and systematically. To Apply: 
Please share your CV along with details of relevant high-rise RCC and structural steel projects handled, including the approximate project size and your role in quantity estimation/BOQ preparation.

Conduct regular site visits and inspections to ensure operational standards are maintained. Ensure proper implementation of SOPs, PSIs, post orders, and client-specific instructions. Identify operational gaps and ensure timely corrective action. 2 . Client Coordination Maintain regular communication with client representatives regarding day-to-day security operations. Attend client meetings and operational review meetings as required. Address client complaints, concerns, and operational requirements promptly. Ensure client instructions are communicated to the site team and implemented effectively. Follow up on client feedback and ensure timely closure of action points. Support client audits, inspections, and operational reviews. 3. Training & Development Ensure all security personnel receive proper induction and site-specific training before deployment. Conduct and monitor refresher training, toolbox talks, emergency response training, fire safety training, and other required programs. Ensure training attendance, assessment records, and training trackers are properly maintained. Conduct periodic awareness sessions on discipline, grooming, customer service, security procedures, and emergency handling. Check security posts, access control, visitor management, patrolling, CCTV monitoring, key management, and other security activities. Verify uniform, grooming, ID cards, equipment, and communication devices. Identify deviations from SOPs and client requirements and ensure corrective action. Prepare site inspection reports and follow up until observations are closed. Monitor the quality of security services and continuously improve operational standards. 5. Equipment & Asset Management Ensure security equipment is available and maintained at all sites. Monitor the issue and usage of walkie-talkies, torches, metal detectors, access-control equipment, and other security assets. Ensure proper maintenance and accountability of company and client assets. Report damaged, missing, or non-functional equipment promptly. Maintain proper records of equipment issued to security personnel. 6. MIS & Reporting Review daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports from all assigned sites. Prepare and submit operational reports to senior management. Monitor manpower, attendance, attrition, training, incidents, inspections, compliance, and client feedback. Track pending action points and ensure timely closure. Provide regular updates on critical operational issues and risks. Ensure all reports are accurate and submitted within defined timelines. Experience in managing multiple client sites and large security manpower. Experience in site inspections, client coordination,training, incident management, and compliance. Knowledge of PSARA, labour compliance, PF, ESI, BGV/PVC, and other applicable statutory requirements. Experience in handling corporate security operations will be preferred. title: Senior Accounts Executive
description:
Key Responsibilities 1. Day-to-Day AP & AR Data Entry Perform daily accounting entries for Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR). Record vendor invoices, customer invoices, credit notes, debit notes, receipts, payments, journal entries and adjustment entries in the accounting system. Check invoices and supporting documents for accuracy, approvals, tax details and correct accounting classification. Process supplier invoices, employee claims and reimbursement entries promptly. Maintain accurate customer and vendor ledgers and ensure transactions are posted on time. File and maintain supporting documents for audit and compliance purposes. 2. Accounts Payable Verify vendor invoices against purchase orders, delivery documents and approvals. Prepare payment schedules and process vendor payments according to agreed credit terms. Reconcile vendor statements and resolve invoice or payment discrepancies. Monitor ageing of payables and maintain accurate supplier records. 3. Accounts Receivable & Billing Prepare customer invoices for projects, recurring services, subscriptions, AMC and managed services contracts. Record customer receipts and allocate payments against outstanding invoices. Monitor AR ageing and follow up with customers on overdue payments. Reconcile customer accounts, resolve billing issues and support collection activities. 4. General Accounting & Closing Maintain the General Ledger, bank books, fixed asset register and supporting schedules. Perform daily and monthly bank reconciliations and account reconciliations. Support month-end and year-end closing, including accruals, prepayments, depreciation and provisions. Assist with the preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements. 5. Taxation, Payroll & Statutory Compliance Handle GST, TDS, Professional Tax, PF, ESI and other applicable statutory requirements. Support payroll processing, statutory deductions and employee reimbursement administration. Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, banks and regulatory authorities. Maintain proper accounting records and documentation for internal and statutory audits. 6. MIS, Budgeting & Financial Analysis Prepare regular MIS reports, cash-flow updates and management summaries. Assist with budgeting, forecasting, cost control and variance analysis. Support project costing and profitability analysis for IT projects and service contracts. Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, controls and automation. 
 Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance or a related discipline. CA Inter, CMA, MBA Finance, ACCA or equivalent qualification will be an added advantage. Minimum 5-10 years of relevant accounting experience, including hands-on ownership of AP and AR entries. Experience managing full sets of accounts, GST, TDS, payroll, audits and month-end closing. Experience in an IT Services, MSP, System Integration, Cloud, Software or Cybersecurity company is preferred. Required Skills Strong working knowledge of Tally Prime, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, SAP Business One, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or a similar ERP/accounting system. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, lookup formulas and MIS reporting. Good knowledge of Indian accounting practices, taxation and statutory compliance. High attention to detail, accuracy, ownership and confidentiality. Ability to work independently, meet deadlines and communicate effectively with customers, vendors and internal stakeholders. 
 Chennai Compensation & Benefits Indicative CTC: INR 7,00,000 - INR 10,00,000 per annum Final compensation will depend on relevant experience, qualifications, current salary and IT industry exposure. Performance-based annual increment and bonus, subject to company policy and individual performance. Provident Fund, ESI and other statutory benefits, as applicable. Medical insurance coverage as per company policy. Casual Leave, Sick Leave and Earned/Privilege Leave as per company policy. Professional training and certification support based on role requirements and approval. Career development opportunities within a growing regional IT and Cybersecurity organization. Exposure to international operations and cross-border finance processes. Additional Preferences Experience with IT project billing, recurring billing, AMC, subscription and managed services revenue models. Experience with multi-company or multi-country accounting will be advantageous. Immediate joiners or candidates with a notice period of 30 days or less will be preferred.
